text.en: Dog and cat owners report high satisfaction with coat treatments, nail trims, and deep brush-out sessions. Reviewers note that heavy shedders like huskies and lab mixes lose significantly less hair after appointments, leaving with clean coats that lack overpowering perfumes.

Clients appreciate the salon's accessible scheduling, frequently finding open slots within a single week rather than waiting months. Pet parents also praise the availability of fast walk-in nail trims that allow dogs to receive quick maintenance without delay.

Reviewers emphasize the salon's patient, gentle approach toward nervous dogs and first-time grooming cats. Pet parents appreciate that groomers take extra time to ensure animals feel secure throughout bathing and drying, resulting in relaxed pets at pickup.

q.en: Does Uptown Pet Salon provide grooming for cats?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm that the salon grooms cats and provides patient care for first-time or nervous feline visitors.

q.en: How far in advance do clients need to book?

a.en: Pet owners note that appointments are typically available within a week, and walk-in nail trims are also accommodated.

q.en: Are the treatments effective for heavy shedding breeds?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight deep brush-out treatments that dramatically reduce loose fur on huskies and lab mixes.
